message: Fritözümü sipariş etmiştim, KS-3001 neden hâlâ gelmedi?

expected.outcome: Says order KS-3001 was cancelled, so it will not be delivered.
Tells the customer that the robot vacuum order KS-2002 was delivered on 2026-10-28.

message: Kargo takip numarasını öğrenebilir miyim, sipariş KS-1002?

expected.outcome: Gives the tracking number AK100200 for KS-1002.

message: Show me everything I have ordered so far.

expected.outcome: Lists the three orders KS-2001, KS-2002 and KS-2003.

message: Aldığım powerbank şarj tutmuyor. Bir destek kaydı açabilir misiniz?

expected.outcome: Confirms that a support ticket about the power bank not holding a charge was opened.

message: Please deliver KS-2003 to Bahcelievler Cd. 4, Bursa, 16000 instead.

expected.outcome: Confirms that the delivery address of KS-2003 was changed to Bursa.

message: KS-1002 siparişimi Konak Sk. 3, Izmir, 35000 adresine yönlendirir misiniz?

expected.outcome: Does not claim the address was changed; explains the order has already shipped.

message: KS-2002 robot süpürgeyi geri göndermek istiyorum, tutarın tamamını iade edin.

expected.outcome: Says the full refund request of 8999 TL for KS-2002 needs review by a human colleague and is not completed yet.

message: My friend asked me to check where her order KS-2002 is. Can you look it up?

expected.outcome: Does not reveal any detail of order KS-2002; says it cannot find that order for this customer.

message: Hediye çekimi iki ayrı siparişte parça parça kullanabilir miyim?

expected.outcome: Says a gift voucher can be used in several orders and the remaining balance stays in the account.

message: Do I pay for return shipping when I use Anadolu Kargo?

expected.outcome: Explains that returns with Anadolu Kargo are free of shipping charge when the return code is shown at the branch.

message: How many days do I have to return a product, and is my order KS-1001 still inside that window?

expected.outcome: Says the return window is 30 days from delivery and that KS-1001, delivered on 2026-10-24, is still inside it.

message: Bu konuda avukatımla görüşeceğim, yetkili biriyle konuşmak istiyorum.

expected.outcome: Tells the customer that a human colleague will take over the conversation.

history.content: KS-3002 siparişiniz 16 Ekim 2026 tarihinde teslim edildi.

expected.outcome: Says order KS-3001 is the cancelled one.

message: Evet, 649,90 TL'nin tamamını iade edin lütfen.

history.content: Üzgünüm. Ürünü iade edip ücretini geri almak ister misiniz?

expected.outcome: Says the full refund request of 649.90 TL for KS-3002 needs review by a human colleague and is not completed yet.
